description: This Java source file defines the TimerNotificationService class which manages timer-related notifications within an Android wearable timer application. It handles actions such as showing the timer expiration notification, deleting the timer, and restarting the timer through notifications and intents.

classes.name: TimerNotificationService
classes.description: A service that manages user notifications related to a timer, handling actions to show, delete, or restart the timer.

methods.name: TimerNotificationService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with its tag name.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that is called when the service is created.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Processes incoming intents, deciding which timer action to perform based on the intent's action.

methods.name: restartAlarm
methods.description: Restarts the timer by launching the SetTimerActivity.

methods.name: deleteTimer
methods.description: Cancels the countdown notification, cancels the alarm, and stops the timer.

methods.name: showTimerDoneNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating the timer has finished, with an action to restart it.
